items.title: WMO Executive Council opens 79th session with focus on Early Warnings for All
items.summary: The Executive Council convened in Geneva to review progress on the Early Warnings for All initiative, with member states pressing for accelerated coverage across least-developed countries and small island states.

items.title: ECMWF brings AIFS machine-learning forecasts into operational suite
items.summary: The centre announced its Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System has moved to operational status, running alongside the physics-based model and delivering competitive medium-range skill at a fraction of the compute cost.
items.source_full: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts

items.title: UNFCCC publishes synthesis of updated national climate plans ahead of COP
items.summary: A new synthesis report aggregates the latest nationally determined contributions, signalling incremental ambition but a persistent gap against the 1.5°C pathway as parties prepare for the next Conference.

items.title: Copernicus: May 2026 ranks among warmest on record globally
items.summary: The Copernicus Climate Change Service reports surface air temperatures well above the 1991–2020 average, with notable marine heatwave activity across the Mediterranean and Arabian Gulf.

items.title: NOAA upgrades Global Forecast System with revised convection scheme
items.summary: The latest GFS implementation improves tropical cyclone track guidance and precipitation timing, following a multi-season parallel evaluation.
items.source_full: US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration

items.title: WMO Hydrology: new guidance on transboundary flood forecasting cooperation
items.summary: Fresh operational guidance encourages neighbouring services to share real-time gauge data and harmonise warning thresholds along shared river basins to reduce downstream flood impacts.

items.title: IPCC agrees outline for special report on climate and the cryosphere
items.summary: Meeting in plenary, the panel approved the scope and timeline for a new assessment focused on changes in snow, ice and permafrost and their cascading consequences for water security.

items.title: Carbon Brief analysis: how AI weather models are reshaping operational forecasting
items.summary: A detailed look at the rapid adoption of data-driven forecast systems by national services, the questions they raise about verification and observations, and what it means for the public-private weather enterprise.
